newsitem.title: CANADA: Loewen urges no action on Service bid.
newsitem.headline: Loewen urges no action on Service bid.

text.p: The Loewen Group Inc urged its shareholders Wednesday to take no action regarding Service Corp International's US$45 a share exchange offer for Loewen until the Loewen board makes a recommendation.
"We ask our shareholders to take no action with respect to their shares until the Company's position has been announced," Loewen chief executive Ray Loewen said in a statement.

Loewen, a funeral and cemetery home operator, said it would announce its position after its board meets but it gave no date for that meeting. Service, the biggest funeral home operator in North America, announced a revised bid Wednesday.
